name: UltraGreen.ai Limited
summary: UltraGreen.ai Ltd. engages in the engafluorescence-guided surgery space, pioneering vertical AI tools for precision surgery using data-driven fluorescence imaging solutions. It offers a fluorescence imaging ecosystem that empowers surgeons with enhanced precision and real-time perfusion data, ultimately improving patient outcomes. Its products include: IC-Green/Verdye, IC-Flow Imaging System, PerfusionWorks Quantification Software and UltraGreen Data Systems. The company was founded by Ravinder Sajwan in 2004 and is headquartered in Singapore.
